notes.title: Major Update [2025/08/08]
notes.notes:
Mid-Stage Save Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/e2842ea865b9844f22f82c2964462ccead78fe19.png"]

A map where you can perform a mid-stage save will now appear right after boss battles.  

A total of 14 save slots are available, and difficulty settings will follow the configuration at the time of saving.



Game Over Screen Added



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/2cc8f72710bb96dbaa2933aa38d4476e955bcb49.png"]

A new Game Over screen now appears, showing a summary of your statistics.  

Cute Game Over illustrations have been added depending on the stage and boss.



Cutscene System Improvements

Story cutscenes will now play when you get a Game Over in a boss battle.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/536bd57ebd8c8f96d2f726ef92bb83c9d66d560b.png"]

A Cutscene Replay menu has been added to the main menu.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/1e9f44c77f8d92c515a7d3cd350a3ce31c32ce7c.png"]

An option to skip previously viewed cutscenes has been added to the settings. \[Tutorial and ending cutscenes cannot be skipped.]



Level Design Improvements

Depending on the difficulty, regular enemies may now be replaced with elite enemies that have more challenging patterns.  

The appearance rate of elite enemies can be adjusted in Custom Difficulty.  

With the addition of mid-stage saves, more late-game stages have been added.  

The internal stat scaling method for enemies has been changed.

notes.title: Update [2025/07/02]
notes.notes:
QOL Improvements

You can now move the camera during debugging by moving the mouse to the edge of the screen or using the arrow keys.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/f98209ebf49a098ea796284c1441c4a6b2aa3bfd.png"]

A simple minimap showing stage progress has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/de89a41cf9d17fdb09f5895487ce44cdbdd5121b.png"]



The minimap was designed with expandability in mind.

Currently, it only displays linear maps, but future updates will allow it to show random event maps, save points, and branching paths.





Custom Difficulty Added

The stat adjustment code for difficulty has been significantly revised, and a Custom Difficulty option has been added to allow players to configure it freely.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/300111db9cb185a0a269b9d8351a1895c556fa80.png"]

notes.title: Community Items Released / Future Update Plans
notes.notes:
Community Items

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/74292ca60d6362b2b231aa1bfaf93e09711d3765.png"]

Thanks to the support and interest from our players, Debugging Hero has met the necessary conditions and now features community items.

8 trading cards

6 badges

7 profile backgrounds

5 emoticons

Card drop system: 1 card drops every 30 minutes of playtime (up to 4 cards total)





Update Plans



Since the game’s release, we’ve received a great deal of valuable feedback from players,

which has been instrumental in helping us improve Debugging Hero.



Although development is handled by a solo developer and updates may take time,

but we are carefully planning our next steps with the following key focuses.



Level Design Improvements

Adding more challenging enemies that use debuffs or special patterns

Introducing enemies that support allies instead of just attacking

Diversifying enemy types to improve late-game level design beyond simple stat scaling

Expanding the mid-to-late game stage content

Adding mid-stage save points

Increasing boss pattern variety

Implementing a minimap UI to distinguish normal, boss, and event maps



Content Enhancements

New builds and items

Random events

More diverse enemy combinations within stages

Expanded variety of consumable items



Other improvements are also under consideration.

We always welcome your feedback, so please feel free to share your thoughts on the Steam Community.



Thank you!

notes.title: Update [2025/06/15]
notes.notes:
Throwing Potion Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/7d2a9c560d64fda6a95dcf1767d08af9b83df383.png"]

A new Throwing Potion card has been added as a map clear reward.

The Throwing Potion deals damage to enemies and heals allies based on Kirara’s Strength.

Various potion items can be used to add additional effects to the Throwing Potion.



New Items Added

Eight new potion-type items have been added.

You can carry up to 3 types of potion items in a single run.

Four of these potions apply buffs to allies hit by the potion.

The other four apply debuffs to enemies hit by the potion.



Buff/Debuff System Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/850440767f4c3fc4ff9bc6d78d34ff4a745f5081.png"]

A new system for enhancing or weakening characters via buffs and debuffs has been implemented.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/668346ffdded7802593d4a6f5a260523341cd5c8.png"]

Buff and debuff durations can be modified through debugging abilities.



Game Adjustments

Increased the base stats of the Beginner Hero.

Decreased the spawn rate of the Berserker item series.



New Feature

By default, the spacebar key is now assigned to the “Ally Rally” function instead of directional movement.

When the Ally Rally key is held, allies gather near Kirara.

However, allies who are in the middle of an attack will move to Kirara only after finishing their current action.



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where Sofia’s item enhancement UI would be cut off when holding 8 items.

Zombies in Stage 3 no longer lose HP during cutscenes.

Fixed a bug where Signal Flag was increasing enemy projectile damage.

notes.notes:

 Swift Potion has been renamed to Ring of Agility.


New Item

Manual: Agility

 Cannot be used together with Manual: Strength.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug that occurred when manipulating the Holy Grenade card.
 Fixed an issue where players could proceed to the next map without selecting a clear reward.
 Fixed a bug where allies became overly clustered when transitioning to the next map, disrupting their movement.


Settings

notes.title: Update [2025/06/09]
notes.notes:
Map Clear Reward Reroll Feature Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/28b5279f1a18981d5a64adbf181c9f942b5b736b.png"]

You can now refresh the reward list up to 4 times.

Reroll charges are restored by defeating bosses.



Normal Monster Adjustment

Reduced Strength stats for mid-to-late-game monsters and increased their damage multipliers.



In the later stages, monster stats were disproportionately high compared to variable cards, which significantly reduced the usefulness of debugging.

To address this, Strength stats have been lowered while maintaining overall damage by increasing the damage multiplier. This enhances the impact of Strength debuffs.

Additionally, when using a Hypnosis Coin to convert late-game monsters into allies, their high damage multiplier will allow for better scaling potential.



Boss Monster Adjustment

Simplified the stat increase algorithm upon phase transitions.

Reduced damage multipliers and increased Strength stats for early-to-mid-game bosses.



Previously, when a boss changed phases, stats increased based on the following conditions:
[olist]
If a specific stat had been heavily reduced by debugging, it would increase significantly.

If not, all stats would increase evenly, with the total amount being greater than in case 1.
[/olist]
This system was intended to reward targeted stat reduction, but due to a lack of explanation, many players misunderstood it as the boss simply "undoing your debugging," causing frustration.

This update removes condition 1, so stats will no longer spike back after heavy debuffing.

notes.title: Update [2025/06/06]
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/a1729d84e8d457714b838837c1a693cdc68f41f9.png"]

The difficulty selection UI has been improved.

After completing the tutorial, the game now automatically transitions to the difficulty selection screen.



Item Adjustments



Mana Buckler



An item removed in the demo version has been reintroduced with a new effect.

When Kirara reflects an enemy projectile, a portion of her \[Durability] is directly added to the projectile’s damage.

This also applies to projectiles reflected through the Mirror Shield ability.



Ribbon

Increased the shared Positive Debugging rate for allies. \[Base: 20% → 30%]



Piercing Arrow

Added a Debug Value Amplification effect for all projectiles.



Throwing Daggers

Changed the effect so that Kirara now throws daggers when performing a normal attack, instead of during a dash.



Swift Potion

Removed the Attack Speed Debugging amplification effect that was previously granted through item upgrades.

Added a new effect that reduces Kirara’s dash cooldown.



These changes aim to buff underused items and expand viable build options by introducing synergies between items.

Below is a sample gameplay video showcasing a projectile-focused build using the reworked items.




[previewyoutube="7kdufZs4uxM;full"][/previewyoutube]




Bug Fixes

Enemy projectiles are now forcefully removed when a boss clear cutscene begins,

resolving an issue where lingering projectiles could damage the player during cutscenes.

notes.title: Update [2025/06/05]
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/f6798e1fc5773742521dce8c06c21b5e9d678699.png

 Added explanations for Debuggable Stats.



New Items

Added 3 enhancement items that only appear when you own certain prerequisite items.

Core stats such as Strength and Durability generally scale along a diminishing curve.
Some of the new enhancement items directly add a portion of the stat value to damage, creating a linear growth pattern. This is expected to enhance late-game value for builds that use these items.


Grenade Shards


 Appears when holding Holy Grenade.
 Increases the area of Kirara and allies’ explosion attacks, and directly adds a portion of Kirara’s Strength to the damage.


Manual: Sword Wave


 Appears when holding the Basic Sword Manual.
 Charged attacks additionally launch a projectile slash.


Sword Manual: Strength


 Appears when holding the Basic Sword Manual.
 Charged attacks directly add a portion of Kirara’s Strength to the damage.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where, if a boss phase transitioned during a Game Over (due to allies or traps), the player could start at the beginning of the stage while still holding variable cards.

Sword Manual

Game Adjustments


 The Demon Lord’s boss clear ability has been changed from +1 Variable Card Charge to +1 Reward Option.
 As you progress to later stages, Novice Heroes that appear as rewards will have increased base stats.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue from the last update where map clear rewards overlapped with the pause UI.
 Fixed an issue from the last update where the special card in the normal ending could be discarded, blocking progress.

notes.title: Minor Update [2025/06/03]
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements


 Added a trash icon that allows you to discard variable cards during debugging.
 Reduced the end-lag after Kirara’s basic attack.
 Adjusted the forward movement speed during Kirara’s basic attack and slightly increased the forward range of the attack effect.
 Heal cards can no longer restore HP beyond the character’s [Max Hp].
 However, [+] and [×] variable cards can still modify [Hp] beyond [Max Hp].

notes.title: Minor Update [2025/06/02]
notes.notes:
Item Adjustments

Hypnosis Coin


 Removed debugging amplification effect for allies.
 Added effect: Debugging of [Hostility] is amplified up to 50% based on enemy [Hp] (lower [Hp] → stronger effect).
 Increased base [Hostility] value of enemies by 50%.



Mirror Shield


 Removed debugging option for projectile [Speed].
 Changed effect: Reflects enemy projectiles if their [Damage] is reduced to 0.
 Reflected projectile [Damage] is determined by Kirara’s [Durability].



Defense Adjustment


 [Durability]-based damage reduction has been decreased.



Music Adjustment


 Fixed an issue where there was a 0.2 second delay in music loop points.

notes.title: Minor Update [2025/06/01]

Difficulty Adjustment

 In Hard difficulty, all enemies have increased stats overall.


Bug Fixes


 Adjusted the player’s attack effect so that, when using the Berserker Spear item, even enemies at very close range are hit properly.


Other Fixes


 The music during the ending cutscene has been changed to the dedicated ending theme.

notes.title: Minor Update [2025/05/31]
